kebab_example: aliyun iotcc create-iot-cloud-connector-group --name cctest --description test --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --dry-run false --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --type Standard --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateIoTCloudConnectorGroup

parameters.help_en:
The name of the instance group.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, start with a letter (uppercase or lowercase) or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
实例组的名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the instance group.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, start with a letter or Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
实例组的描述信息。
长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without creating the instance group. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建实例组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html API to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例组所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the cloud connector instance. Different editions have different feature limitations and billing policies. Valid values:

Basic: Basic Edition.

Standard: Standard Edition.

<props="china">By default, cloud connector instances are created as Standard Edition. To create a Basic Edition instance, submit a ticket (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today).</props>

<props="intl">By default, cloud connector instances are created as Standard Edition. To create a Basic Edition instance, submit a ticket (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.11182188.console-base-top.dworkorder.18ae4882n3v6ZW#/ticket/createIndex).</props>
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例的版本，不同版本有不同功能限制和计费策略。取值：

Basic：基础版。

Standard：标准版。

<props="china">云连接器实例默认创建标准版，如果需要创建基础版实例，请提交工单 (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today)申请。</props>

<props="intl">云连接器实例默认创建标准版，如果需要创建基础版实例，请提交工单 (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.11182188.console-base-top.dworkorder.18ae4882n3v6ZW#/ticket/createIndex)申请</props>
parameters.name: type
